title: Honeyed Ukrainian Grapes Agemono-Deep-Fry
description: Earthy, light Ukrainian dish featuring grapes and agemono-deep-fry, perfect for brunch, and FODMAP-friendly

ingredients.name: Grapes
ingredients.notes: any variety, but firmer grapes work best

instructions: In a large bowl, mix together cornstarch and flour to create a uniform coating mixture.
In a separate bowl, whisk together egg and a pinch of salt.
Add the grapes to the egg mixture and toss to coat.
Roll the grape clusters in the cornstarch mixture to coat evenly.
Heat the vegetable oil in a deep frying pan or a deep fryer to 325°F (165°C).
Carefully place the coated grape clusters into the hot oil, a few at a time, to avoid overcrowding.
Fry the grapes for 2-3 minutes or until they turn golden brown.
Remove the fried grapes from the oil with a slotted spoon and place them on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
Drizzle the honey over the fried grapes and toss to coat evenly.
